Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book my 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. Looking at my calendar, I have these free slots that fit within working hours:

- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30

Does any of those work for you? Happy to move things if you have a different preference.

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to get our 30-minute 1:1 on the calendar for next week. Times that are free on my side:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Would any of those work for you? If none do, tell me a slot that suits you and I'll rearrange.

Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my schedule, I could do:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30

Hi Sarah — Monday 14:00-14:30 works for me. I've put it on my calendar for next week; see you then. (Thursday 14:00-14:30 would clash with my Thursday 12:50-14:20 PhD student 1:1 block, and Wednesday 15:00 would sit right against the department seminar, so Monday is the clean choice.)

Hi Diego — Monday 10:00-10:30 works. I've booked it for next week. (Monday 14:00-14:30 is gone to Sarah, Tuesday 11:00 I'm keeping for another 1:1, and Friday 11:00-11:30 collides with paper review.)

Dear Priya — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 works for me; it's booked for next week.

Monday 14:00-14:30 went to Sarah, Monday 10:00-10:30 to Diego, Thursday 14:00-14:30 overlaps my Thursday PhD 1:1 block, and Friday 11:00-11:30 collides with paper review. See you Tuesday.

— Professor Alvarez
Perfect — Monday 14:00-14:30 it is. I've put it in my calendar and logged it. See you then!
Monday 10:00-10:30 it is — thanks. I've put it in my calendar for next Monday. See you then.

Thank you — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is in my calendar. See you then.

Priya

— Professor Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, I'm free Monday 14:00-14:30, Tuesday 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30, and Wednesday 10:00-10:30. Would one of those suit you, or is there another time you'd prefer? Once you confirm I'll put it in my calendar.

Monday 14:00-14:30 is Sarah's, Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is Priya's, and Wednesday 10:00-10:30 I've already offered to John. See you Tuesday.

(Monday 10:00-10:30 is Diego's.) See you Thursday.
